about: Long master (talking head, podcast, course video) before review or delivery: grade applied, faces inside the frame, secrets on screen, text colliding or cut by the frame edge after scene changes (cards, titles). No hook or caption checks (masters carry neither); captions burned into a master: add the short pack's caption_off_face. video_ci.py widens every step on long files so a check never takes more than 150 stills.

checks.ask: The person's head is cropped by the side of the frame.
checks.yes: the frame edge cuts through the face or head, so an eye, cheek or half the face is missing
checks.no: the whole head is inside the frame, or no person is shown

checks.ask: The image has strong contrast with deep black shadows.
Private information is readable on screen: a password, Wi-Fi network key, email address, phone number, access code or API key.
Two lines of overlay text sit on top of each other and collide.
checks.yes: letters of one text line are drawn over letters of another text line, even faintly
checks.no: every text line has its own clear space; no letters cross other letters
checks.why: calibrated on 120 stills taken just after scene changes of 6 shipped renders (9:16 + 16:9) + mutants: two captions overlapping (one at 55 % opacity = crossfade) 0.77-0.97, clean frames max 0.57 (a prompter screen full of text); AUC 1.00

checks.ask: The edge of the video frame cuts through the letters of a caption or title.
checks.yes: a caption or title line starts or ends outside the frame, its letters sliced by the outer border of the video
checks.no: all captions and titles sit fully inside the video frame; text clipped by a software window, photo or document border does not count
checks.why: calibrated on the same 120 stills: caption pushed past the left or right edge 0.39-0.9 (mean 0.62), clean max 0.42 (prompter text clipped by its own window); AUC 1.00, borderline frames land amber
